description: Discover the best hotels in Mornington Peninsula, Australia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Multi-Award-Winning Mornington Peninsula Wine Lovers' Haven with Hatted Restaurant & Spa
hotels.description: Treat yourself to ultimate luxury in the Mornington Peninsula wine region at this multi-award-winning stay. This whimsical, show-stopping hotel draws you down a rabbit hole of art installations, chef-hatted cuisine and fine wines, all while offering the highest level of service and breathtaking vineyard surrounds. Sit under a 10,000 globe chandelier at Doot Doot Doot, one of Victoria's best restaurants, savour woodfired fare at Rare Hare, cheers to your stay over delectable wines and cocktails at Flaggerooot, melt away during a hot stone massage at the spa and plunge into the 30-metre infinity pool during your acclaimed winery stay.

hotels.title: Mornington Peninsula Vineyard Luxury with Award-Winning Dining, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Perched on the edge of LL Vineyard just an hour from Melbourne, Jackalope Hotel is a bold, art-laden retreat that has redefined luxury on the Mornington Peninsula. Floor-to-ceiling windows and a curated collection of inhabitable artworks make every room a destination in its own right. This is an experience tailored to those who appreciate the finer things. Each morning, breakfast at the acclaimed Doot Doot Doot draws on the kitchen garden and the Peninsula's finest produce. Lunch is a share-plate affair at Rare Hare, the beloved food and wine store set within the vines next door. For Lair Suite guests, a guaranteed dinner reservation at Doot Doot Doot is an eye-opening experience, set beneath the canopy of a 10,000-globe chandelier. Beyond the table, the 30-metre infinity pool laps at the surrounding vines and daily guest experiences - from morning yoga and cookie-making classes to a wine cellar tour and cheese tasting - ensure no two days look the same.

hotels.title: Boutique Mornington Peninsula Lancemore Winery Stay Just 90 Minutes from Melbourne
hotels.description: Hidden among the Mornington Peninsula's vine-clad hills, sweeping bushland and windswept cliffs lies Lancemore Lindenderry Red Hill, the perfect boutique retreat only 90 minutes from Melbourne's CBD. The porcelain-white boutique hotel stands tall in the centre of 34 acres of romantic greenery, offering guests European-style accommodation with a modern Australian twist, and is the perfect base to experience the region's treasure trove of artisanal distilleries, cherished cool-climate vineyards, seaside villages and tremendous natural beauty. Savour exceptional fare at The Dining Room restaurant or for those who like to sip throughout their trip, the Lancemore Lindenderry Red Hill's cellar door is the place to discover award-winning wines.

hotels.title: Mornington Peninsula Escape with Daily Breakfast, Golf Discounts & Hot Springs Upgrades Available
hotels.description: Swing into a secluded coastal escape at this romantic retreat, perfectly located only moments from the award-winning Peninsula Hot Springs. Crowning the entry to two 18-hole championship golf courses, this upscale oasis boasts sweeping vistas from every angle, with each room and suite offering private balconies with glorious rolling green views. Tee off at first light or linger over a leisurely breakfast at the onsite Pebbles Restaurant as golden sunrises wash across the fairways. Spend afternoons unwinding with a rejuvenating soak at nearby Peninsula Hot Springs, exploring cellar doors and beach-framed towns dotted along the Mornington Peninsula or strolling coastal trails at Cape Schanck before retreating to your spacious, contemporary stay. Savour every bite at Pebbles Restaurant, which showcases the best of Victoria’s seasonal produce, expertly paired with exquisite local wines - think chips triple-fried in duck fat, stuffed king mushrooms and olive oil cake parfaits. Whether you’re seeking a golfer’s getaway, a gourmet escape or a tranquil couples’ retreat, this refined haven delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and recreation in one of Victoria’s most coveted coastal enclaves.
